The '''2026–27 season''' is [[Al-Nassr FC|Al-Nassr]]'s 51st consecutive season in the top flight of [[Football in Saudi Arabia|Saudi football]] and 71st year in existence as a [[Football club (association football)|football club]]. It includes participation in the [[2026–27 Saudi Pro League|Pro League]], the [[2026–27 King's Cup (Saudi Arabia)|King’s Cup]], the [[2026 Saudi Super Cup|Super Cup]], and the [[2026–27 AFC Champions League Elite|AFC Champions League Elite]]. The competitive fixtures began with the opening of the league on 13 August.
